Author: Chittaranjan Dash
Bench: Chittaranjan Dash
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack

 Pradeep @ Pradep Kisan .... Petitioner
 Mr. A.K. Sahoo, Advocate

 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. Shashanka Patra, A.S.C.
 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 376(2)(n)/417, I.P.C. in connection with Kundheigola P.S. Case No.39 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. No.66 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned J.M.F.C., Reamal.
3. It emerges from the F.I.R. that the victim is aged about 37 years old whereas the Petitioner is aged 23 years.
According to the allegations, about four years prior to the F.I.R. the Petitioner and the Informant had established physical relation under the pretext of getting married to each other.

However, no such material appears from the F.I.R. as regards the offence under Section 493, I.P.C.
Further the informant being in considerable age seems more matured than the Petitioner and as such was well aware of the consequences when established the physical contact.

// 2 //
4. Having regard to the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, nature of the allegations as emerged from the materials on record, the circumstances appearing and the seriousness and gravity of the offences, while this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that the Petitioner if so chooses may surrender before the learned J.M.F.C., Reamal in the aforesaid C.T. Case No.66 of 2023 during the first hour within three weeks from today and move for Pradeep @ Pradep Kisan vs State Of Odisha ....

1 bail.
In such event, the learned Magistrate shall consider the bail application of the Petitioner in the first hour of the day itself, strictly on the basis of the materials available on record.
In case of rejection of the bail application by the learned Magistrate, the Petitioner may move for bail before the higher forum in the second hour of the same day.

In that event, the higher forum shall consider and dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day on merit, strictly on the basis of the materials available on record without being influenced by any observation made herein by this Court or presuming it to be a direction in affirmative.
5. However, this order is subject to verification of criminal antecedents of the Petitioner.
6. The Case Diary be made available to the learned courts below as far as possible to facilitate disposal of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day itself.
However, the learned courts shall apply their own wisdom in dealing with the application for bail.
7. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
